notes.title: 1,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
In less than one month since launching the Steam page for Battle Boss, it has already crossed the 1,000 wishlist milestone! I never expected to hit this milestone this quickly - but, here we are!

I'm incredibly thankful for the support so far, and I can't wait to have the demo published so everyone can play!

As a special surprise for checking out this news post, here's a concept art of a new battlemon - Torchtail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614878/44912faafef657f4f37eba4f3593622dceb944d0.png[/img]

notes.title: 300 Wishlists!
notes.content:
In less than a week, Battle Boss has reached over 300 wishlists! I couldn't have imagined how great the response would to its announcement, and I'm so appreciative of everyone that has shown their support!

Here's to many more milestones to come!
